title: Outcomes of CPM Usage Following Arthroscopic Acetabular Labral Repair
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to measure whether CPM (continuous passive motion) usage improves outcomes following arthroscopic hip surgery that includes labral repair. Investigators tested the hypothesis that CPM usage reduces pain levels and pain medication use and improves function in individuals who undergo hip arthroscopy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* undergoing hip arthroscopy to repair a torn labrum

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* revision surgery
* bilateral surgery
